finish.summary: Solved libero_spatial task 5 seed 2 in one attempt (no resets, 8 env steps). Task language was "pick up the black bowl on the ramekin and place it on the plate" — note the relation is flipped vs the seed-0 task-family memory (which names the bowl on the cookie box), so I picked the upper-right bowl elevated on the gray ramekin and treated the cookie-box bowl as the distractor. SAM3 returned score 0.973 but its mask landed on the cookie-box bowl (the exact documented failure mode), so identity came from agentview RGB support-object classification; back_project region mode gave target bowl (-0.207, 0.196, z=0.964) and plate (0.042, 0.210, top z=0.9082), with the wrist accepted only as a ±1.5 cm geometry refinement. A short generic pi0_pick ("pick up the black bowl", 14 chunks) succeeded in 7 chunks; the thin-rim grasp (opening 0.0037) was confirmed visually (bowl lifted, ramekin empty), firmed with set_gripper +1, and the held offset was measured per pick from agentview (bowl = eef + (+0.007, -0.047)). Two gripper:+1 carry hops at z=1.10 brought the bowl to within 8 mm of the plate center, two capped descents to eef z=0.985 rested it on the plate, and release fired terminated:true on the first try. Audit and recipe written to the online-task directory.
